title: Said to Contain Errors
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 175
medium: Interactive page (index.html, plain DOM and SVG built in the browser, no library): 24 US river gauges drawn as rivers whose width is the October 2026 flow a list gives them, under two lists (the truth reversed, and the truth); the visitor judges which is wrong, then sees what four arms of machine instances said and answered, the Vicksburg daily record the instances refused, and every arm's answers for 32 other gauges against the truth. A figure (figure.svg); Python for fetch, preparation, scoring, face data and figure; twenty-four briefs and hand-backs, the practice's coding and a blind second coding, predictions pushed before any maker ran, the raw USGS response.
embodies: A machine judge checks what it is told against its picture of the normal, not against the teller: asserted or doubted, an impossible reversal is set aside, and a true flood offered with leave to doubt is refused as an error.
result: P0 held (U SD of log10 medians 0.824, rho 0.900). P1 held (D named 6 of 6, VALUES 6 of 6, rho +0.886). P2 failed (R rho +0.872, not below 0; R named 6 of 6, VALUES 6 of 6). P3 failed (no difference between D and R). P4 failed (T rho 0.889 against U 0.900 within 0.05, but level error 0.164 not below U's 0.163, and 5 of 6 named the true list as not fitting). P5 held (0 of 24 knew). Blind coder agreed on all 18 for naming and blame. S173.OWN falsified at its event (clauses 1 and 3).
project_step: Fifty-second experiment of the project. Operation: judging what one is told, and where the judge puts the fault. Takes up Session 174's open thread 2 (a brief that does not assert the told values) and thread 1 (a blame rule that separates the measure from the family's expectation, sharpened in PREDICTIONS.md and agreed 18 of 18 by a blind coder). Builds on experiment 51 (Read Backwards), whose reversed arm it repeats on a new material and beside which it sets the sentence of doubt, and on experiments 45 to 47, whose check against a held order it meets again. Works against Cartography, not Tracing (reproducing as watching the flow from the bank, following as the search for a material's singularities, ATP 372) in the making: the face draws the flow and asks the visitor to judge it before showing that the machine's bank refused the month's one singularity.
material: USGS Water Services daily mean discharge (00060), 1-31 October 2026, provisional, 56 gauges drawn by seed 175 from 68 with all 31 days (93 listed from memory before any value was seen). Domain: how much water rivers carry. US public domain.

data_sources.what: daily mean discharge for the 93 candidate gauges, fetched 2026-11-11 (sources/usgs-dv-2026-10.json; per-site means and qualifiers in sources/october-2026.json)

seed: prepare.py seed 175 (selection of 56 from 68, contact/scored split); reversed deal by rank, rho -1.00; blind coding order seed 1752; makers are model instances and not seeded
